_comment: Copy this to accounts.json (GITIGNORED) to hold MULTIPLE named accounts per platform for the hub's <prefix>_account_* tools. env values may be literal secrets OR ${ENV} references resolved from the hub's environment at spawn time. Prefer ${ENV} refs so this file stays secret-free. Env-mode platforms: runpod, kaggle, modal, lightning, ovh, rclone. CLI-mode platforms (azure, gcloud) need NO entries here -- their accounts are the CLI's own profiles (az subscriptions / gcloud configurations) and are managed live via the az_/gc_ account tools. If an env-mode platform is omitted and ALL its registration (seed_env) vars are present in the hub env, the hub seeds a single in-memory 'default' account automatically -- EXCEPT rclone, which has no seed_env (its RCLONE_URL comes from spec.env, so it never auto-seeds a default). OVH note: each ovh account bundles OVH_ENDPOINT (ovh-eu | ovh-ca | ovh-us) alongside its creds, so ov_account_switch flips BOTH region and credentials. Creds may be the API-key trio (OVH_APPLICATION_KEY/SECRET/CONSUMER_KEY -- create at ovh.com/auth/api/createToken) OR OAuth2 (OVH_CLIENT_ID/OVH_CLIENT_SECRET); the env bundle is auth-agnostic.
